## Search engine optimization

One of the most overlooked aspects of localization is SEO. Many brands underestimate that most potential customers never see their site because it does not index in foreign search engines. Even if buyers speak English, they often search in their native language. Glopal solves this by deploying fully localized, SEO-optimized versions of your store designed for foreign language search engines. Each site includes translated meta tags, self-referencing canonical URLs, Hreflang declarations, and sitemaps, with the flexibility to be set up as a local top-level domain, subdomain, or directory—ensuring maximum visibility and international organic growth.

* Overview
* Meta Tags
* Robots.txt

* SEO Explained

OverviewMeta TagsRobots.txtSitemapsCanonical URLsHref LangDomainsSEO Explained

All meta tags, including title, description, and keywords, are automatically translated in real time. Any updates made to these tags on your domestic store are instantly reflected in your international stores with a fully translated version.

By default, Glopal automatically generates localized robots.txt files for your international stores to help search engines index content. These files can be customized per store, allowing you to prioritize specific content and optimize crawler capacity for better search performance.

Glopal automatically creates localized sitemaps, mirroring your original store’s sitemap to help search engines efficiently crawl and index your international store versions.

Self-referencing canonical URLs ensure that multiple localized versions of your page are correctly recognized by search engines, preventing duplicate indexing. This helps consolidate SEO value across international markets while maintaining a clear and optimized search presence.

The hreflang attribute signals to Google which language and country a specific page is targeting. This ensures that international versions of your store do not compete with your domestic market in search results. It also helps prevent duplicate content issues in regions that share the same language, ensuring each version is correctly indexed for its intended audience.

For local versions of your store to index correctly, they must be hosted and served as fully standalone sites. This can be achieved through various approaches, including a separate local domain, a subdomain, or a directory structure on your main domain.

## Tax & Duty Calculation

Tax and duty compliance is key to meeting legal requirements and ensuring customer satisfaction. Transparent pricing, smooth customs clearance, and eliminating surprise fees build trust and improve the buying experience. Optimizing tax and duty enhances customer confidence and unlocks cost savings through strategies like B2B2C company setups and reverse tax and duty calculations. A seamless post purchase experience strengthens loyalty. Glopal’s after sales suite simplifies tax and duty calculations, international shipping and returns, compliance solutions, and email translation, ensuring a smooth experience that builds trust and drives customer satisfaction.

Our automated HS classification tool streamlines global trade compliance with speed and accuracy. By automatically assigning the correct Harmonized System (HS) codes, it ensures accurate tax and duty calculations, reduces customs delays, and minimizes compliance risks. Seamlessly integrated into your store, it simplifies cross-border selling, saving time and ensuring a smoother experience for both merchants and buyers.

Our document generation tool simplifies international shipping by automatically creating the necessary customs and compliance documents for cross-border orders. From commercial invoices to tax and duty declarations, it ensures shipments meet regulatory requirements, reducing the risk of delays, fines, or returns. Fully automated and integrated into your workflow, it saves time, minimizes errors, and ensures a smoother shipping experience for both merchants and buyers.

Our compliance tool ensures that all shipments meet import and export regulations, preventing prohibited items from being listed or shipped in restricted markets. By automatically screening products against country-specific regulations, it helps merchants avoid penalties, delays, and compliance risks. We continuously monitor the latest trade laws, tariff changes, and customs requirements, keeping your store up to date and fully compliant so you can expand globally with confidence.

# Glopal
> Glopal is a full-stack cross-border ecommerce platform that lets brands launch and run fully localized versions of their online store in 100+ markets - combining ecommerce translation and localization, localized checkout, real-time duties and tax calculation, and international performance marketing in one platform.
## What Glopal is
Glopal is a cross-border ecommerce platform for brands and retailers selling internationally. It is headquartered in Paris, France, and raised a EUR 20m Series A round in March 2023.
Glopal covers four functions that brands otherwise buy from separate vendors:
1. \*\*Ecommerce translation and localization\*\* - AI-assisted human-quality translation of storefronts, product catalogues, themes and metadata into 20+ languages, plus localization of currency, sizing, imagery and payment methods.
2. \*\*Localized checkout\*\* - market-specific checkout with local currency, local payment methods and guaranteed landed cost shown before purchase.
3. \*\*Duties, tax and trade compliance\*\* - real-time duties and import tax calculation, automated HS code classification, DDP support, customs documentation, and de minimis threshold handling.
4. \*\*International performance marketing\*\* - international Google Shopping and Meta campaign management, international SEO, and localized feed management for cross-border campaigns.
Glopal serves large and enterprise brands, with concentration in fashion, lifestyle, apparel and sports. It also works through agencies and platform partners.
## Who Glopal is for
- Direct-to-consumer and retail brands with an established domestic store expanding into new international markets
- Brands on Shopify, BigCommerce or Magento 2 that need more than a translation plugin
- Brands that need duties and tax handled at checkout rather than surprising the buyer at delivery
- Merchants running international paid acquisition who need localized storefronts behind the ads
- Agencies managing international expansion on behalf of client brands
## How Glopal compares
Glopal is most often evaluated against three kinds of vendor:
- \*\*Website translation tools\*\* (Weglot, WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Transcy, ConveyThis, Linguise, Smartcat, Shopify Translate & Adapt). These translate site content. Glopal also translates, but adds localized checkout, duties and tax, and international marketing - so it is chosen when translation alone does not close the gap on international conversion.
- \*\*Full-stack cross-border platforms\*\* (Global-e, ESW, Passport, Reach, Flow). Comparable scope. Glopal differs in offering localized storefronts and international marketing as part of the same platform rather than checkout-only or logistics-only.
- \*\*Duties and tax specialists\*\* (Zonos, Avalara Cross-Border, Fonoa). These solve landed cost and compliance. Glopal includes that capability alongside localization and marketing.
Glopal is not a general-purpose translation management system for software localization, and it is not a marketing agency retainer. It is a platform for cross-border ecommerce revenue.
